remarks:
Beautifully maintained and thoughtfully designed, this 4-bedroom, 2-bath raised ranch offers a spacious and versatile layout on a generous half-acre lot, complemented by concrete curbing that adds a polished, well-defined finish to the landscaping. With an attached 2-car garage, multiple living areas, and inviting outdoor spaces, this home provides plenty of room for everyday living, entertaining, and relaxing. 
A charming front porch framed by impressive two-story pillars creates an inviting first impression. Inside, the entryway leads to the bright and airy main level, where the spacious living room is filled with natural light and offers a comfortable setting for relaxing or entertaining. Just off the living room, the eat-in kitchen features a convenient breakfast bar for additional seating and workspace, along with new appliances, including a dishwasher, stove, hood range, sink, and faucet. The newer sliding glass doors open from the kitchen to the large back deck, providing a seamless transition to outdoor living. Enjoy scenic views from the deck while dining al fresco, entertaining guests, or simply taking in the peaceful surroundings. The main level is completed by two comfortable bedrooms and a full bathroom featuring a relaxing jetted tub. The lower level expands the living space with a spacious family room featuring sliding glass doors that open to a large patio and covered porch. A convenient full bathroom is located adjacent to the family room. Two additional bedrooms complete the lower level, providing flexible space for family members, guests, a home office, or other needs. Outside, the large backyard offers plenty of room for recreation, gardening, entertaining, or simply enjoying the scenic setting. The combination of a spacious deck, covered porch, patio, and generous yard creates multiple opportunities to enjoy the outdoors. Updated: whole house interior professionally painted & new roof (2023). Conveniently located just a short drive from Royalton Ravine Park and Olcott Beach, this property provides easy access to hiking, outdoor recreation, swimming, and waterfront activities.
